method: Galerkin (hat/PV) discretisation of the symmetrized integral operator of the statement, d_tau s = Int_0^1 S(x,y) s'''(y) dy, with s(0)=0 and s'(1)=s''(1)=0; PV integrals in the potential form d_x Int K s'''; spectrum of A=M D3 (uniform FD D3), Richardson-extrapolated in 1/N; one discrete D3 null mode discarded.
